settings.title: Settings
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another application
settings.no_masters_description: Install Carbonio CE on another node and configure it as main server of a multi-server installation, with new servers accepted.
settings.lets_encrypt_tips: The certificate is also used by SMTP, IMAP and POP3.
settings.admin_host_helper: Optional: a second host name that opens the Carbonio Admin Panel. Leave empty to reach it only from the node.
settings.host_cannot_change: The host name cannot change after the first setup
settings.admin_host_is_host: Use a host name different from the webmail one
settings.join_not_found: This main server does not exist or does not accept new servers
settings.join_release_mismatch: The main server runs another Carbonio release: update both first
settings.mail_module_on_node: Another mail application uses the IMAP/POP3 ports of this node: {value}
settings.mail_port_in_use: These IMAP/POP3 ports are in use on this node: {value}
settings.proxy_description: An extra entry point of a Carbonio installation: webmail, IMAP and POP3 for every mailbox server of the main server it joins. Mail transfer (SMTP) stays on the main server.
settings.proxy_host_helper: Webmail address of this proxy and its IMAP/POP3 server name. It cannot change later.
settings.proxy_lets_encrypt_tips: The certificate is also used by IMAP and POP3.
settings.proxy_first_setup_description: The first configuration installs the Carbonio proxy: it takes a few minutes.
